external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in to the admin console with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users and support agents.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it checks invoice company ownership when loading by invoice number. Nobody wrote down whether it checks the user's role again when a request arrives.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID the job carries.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself. The database has no row-level security. The app connects with one database account for all companies. Nobody recorded how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket holding rendered PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the PDF renderer ... writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. Nobody recorded how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A customer user signs in to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password, and session cookie

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company. Invoice numbers count up from 1000 across all companies.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number and invoice data

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits the whole invoice to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back, and the billing app saves every field it receives
data_flows.notes: This includes the paid flag and the company's payout bank account. Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks the user's role again when a request arrives.
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, paid flag, and payout bank account

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app to create a PDF for an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number and PDF request

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code.
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open session
data_flows.description: A support agent opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded against the customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session activity

data_flows.name: query and save
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and saves tenant data in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice changes

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the database.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries. Nobody recorded how the renderer reaches the bucket.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The billing app uses one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: record user action
data_flows.description: The billing app records customer-user activity in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Support-agent activity recorded against a customer user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents use the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console is internal because it is reachable only from the support office network.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing customer and financial information.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the bucket stores PDFs generated from invoices and bank details.
